ups-amazon-glide-down.n: UPS Amazon cutback and network overhaul
ups-amazon-glide-down.s: UPS says the Amazon scale-down finished in Q2 and has raised its 2026 revenue and profit outlook.

beats.h511: In April 2025 UPS put numbers on the cuts: about 20,000 jobs and 73 buildings by the end of June, targeting about $1 billion in savings.

cx.intro: UPS is shrinking its Amazon business and rebuilding its network; shippers now face their first peak season after the cutback.
cx.now: UPS says the Amazon volume reduction and network reconfiguration are complete.

fedex-freight-spin.s: FedEx completed the FedEx Freight spin-off on June 1, 2026; FedEx Freight trades as FDXF and FedEx kept 19.9% at separation.

cx.intro: FedEx split off its LTL arm, FedEx Freight, as its own public company. Shippers watch who runs each side of the network.

fedex-network-2.s: FedEx is integrating Ground and Express pickup and delivery market by market, with completion slated for 2027.

beats.a3623effd6df4: In Mesquite, Texas, Express and Ground parcels now share a building and vans. The CEO said Network 2.0 would be 62% done by year-end.

cx.now: Dallas and San Francisco are done, Los Angeles is next after the holidays, and full completion is slated for 2027.

usps-air-cargo.n: USPS air cargo shifts from FedEx to UPS
usps-air-cargo.s: UPS took over USPS domestic air cargo from FedEx as the FedEx contract expired.

beats.h407: UPS said April 1, 2024 it would be USPS's main air carrier for at least five and a half years; FedEx said extension talks failed.
beats.h425: FedEx's deal ended Sept. 29, 2024 and UPS's began the next day; FedEx had flagged a $500 million fiscal 2025 profit headwind.

cx.intro: UPS replaced FedEx as the Postal Service's main air cargo carrier, a big contract swing for both companies.
cx.now: The handover is done: UPS is USPS's primary air cargo carrier, and FedEx planned to cut related air network costs.

de-minimis.n: End of de minimis and low-value imports
de-minimis.s: Duty-free de minimis treatment remains suspended for all countries, and CBP has proposed earlier filing deadlines for low-value imports.

beats.h420: Sept. 2024: a proposal to curb the $800 exemption for tariffed goods, as shipments grew from about 140 million to over 1 billion a year.
beats.h504: USPS stopped taking China and Hong Kong parcels Feb. 4, then reversed a day later to work with CBP on collecting duties.
beats.h513: May 2, 2025: the exemption ends for China and Hong Kong; postal parcels face 120% of value or $100 per item, rising to $200 on June 1.
beats.h526: Aug. 29: it ends for all countries, and the UPU says at least 25 countries halted postal shipments to the U.S.
beats.a2f683da86bf8: CBP pushed a postal formal-entry date from Oct. 22, 2026 to Jan. 20, 2027; it also proposed earlier filing deadlines Oct. 8.

cx.intro: How duty-free $800 imports ended, first for China and then for everyone, and what that means for shippers.
cx.now: De minimis stays suspended for all countries; the formal-entry compliance date for certain postal goods is now Jan. 20, 2027.

tariff-refunds.s: FedEx's tariff class actions are consolidated in Memphis at the pleading stage, while its own customer refund program proceeds separately.

beats.g31: FedEx started $800M in refunds with no application needed; UPS applied for $500M and DHL filed claims where it was importer.
beats.a0b5708b9f70d: Reportedly, 13 suits are now combined in Memphis with interim class counsel; no class is certified and the claims are unproven.

cx.intro: Carriers are passing on IEEPA tariff refunds while FedEx faces class actions; shippers want their money back.
cx.now: Reportedly, a consolidated complaint is proposed for Nov. 4 and FedEx's reply Dec. 4; refunds still run through its own program.

carrier-gri.s: UPS's average net 5.9% increase takes effect Dec. 21, 2026, after FedEx and DHL Express set the same average for January 2027.

beats.h401: FedEx's 5.9% took effect Jan. 1, 2024, after UPS's matching 5.9% began Dec. 26. Both were down from 6.9% a year earlier.
beats.h421: FedEx set 5.9% again for Jan. 6, 2025, with two-day air and long-distance ground rising by more than the average.
beats.h424: DHL Express followed with a 5.9% average for U.S. accounts from Jan. 1, 2025, matching FedEx and UPS.
beats.h426: UPS also landed on 5.9% for 2025, starting Dec. 23, 2024, a few days ahead of the prior year's Dec. 26 start.
beats.h529: FedEx's Jan. 5, 2026 increase stayed at 5.9%, and residential delivery went to $6.95 from $6.55.
beats.02: DHL Express also set 5.9% for U.S. accounts on Jan. 1, 2027. Some services and surcharges change too, but DHL didn't list them.
beats.07: UPS hasn't announced its 2027 increase yet. In recent years it has followed FedEx by two to three weeks and matched the 5.9% headline.
beats.w84705482dd2f: UPS set a 5.9% average increase for Ground, Air and International Daily Rates from Dec. 21, 2026.

cx.intro: Carriers keep announcing 5.9% average rate increases each year; UPS, DHL and FedEx have each set 5.9% again.
cx.now: UPS's 5.9% average increase takes effect Dec. 21, 2026, DHL's 5.9% on Jan. 1 and FedEx's 5.9% on Jan. 4, 2027.

usps-pricing.s: USPS set July 13, 2025 shipping price increases, with Ground Advantage up about 7.1%, after earlier annual and mid-year changes.

beats.h402: Jan. 21, 2024: Ground Advantage rose 5.4%, Priority Mail 5.7% and Express 5.9%, and none of the three changed in July 2024.
beats.h409: USPS proposed a 25% average Parcel Select increase for July 14, 2024, and no increases for Ground Advantage, Priority Mail or Express.
beats.h430: The Nov. 2024 proposal for Jan. 19, 2025 had Ground Advantage up about 3.9%. Parcel Select, up about 25% in July, was set for another 9.2%.

cx.now: No newer verified milestone.

peak-surcharges.s: Peak surcharges from UPS, FedEx and USPS are in effect through the end of the holiday season, and small retailers report rising shipping costs.

beats.h416: UPS posted its 2024 peak tables in July, adding a second demand fee for customers over 20,000 weekly packages.
beats.h418: FedEx followed in August with a similar two-tier setup, including $0.30–$0.55 on Ground and Home Delivery residential.
beats.h419: USPS proposed its own temporary increase for Oct. 6 to Jan. 19 on Priority Mail Express, Priority Mail and Ground Advantage.
beats.h523: FedEx's 2025 peak fees start Sept. 29, with residential demand at $0.40–$0.65 a package, up from $0.30–$0.55 in 2024.
beats.h527: UPS's fees start Sept. 28 and demand surcharges Oct. 26; high-volume customers pay up to $8.75, matching FedEx's top rate.
beats.06: USPS holiday prices began Oct. 4 on four products, averaging near 6% per trade press, through Jan. 16.
beats.01: Oversize peak fees have billed since Sep 26–28; per-package fees start Oct 24–26, then climb to $0.75–$0.80 in late November.
beats.a663794cc9c55: At $6.28 diesel, UPS's fuel surcharge is 29.5% and FedEx's 29%; an industry index sees Q4 ground pricing up 5.8%, express 13.8%.

cx.intro: Carriers keep layering peak fees over the holidays, and shippers pay them on top of base rates and fuel charges.
cx.now: Per-package peak fees begin Oct. 24 to 26; UPS and Amazon rise to $0.75 from Nov. 22 and FedEx to $0.80 from Nov. 23.

import-export-fees.s: FedEx added per-pound demand fees on U.S. imports and raised export fees, following UPS's earlier surge fees.

beats.h530: UPS went first: $0.23/lb on Europe-to-U.S. express and $0.47/lb from India from Sept. 28, through Jan. 17, 2026. China was excluded.
beats.31: FedEx's fees run until further notice: imports $0.12 to $0.25/lb by region, and its export fee rose from $0.20 to $0.30.

cx.intro: UPS and FedEx now add per-pound fees on international parcels, which raises the cost of imports and exports.

usps-leadership.s: The source still identifies David Steiner as Postmaster General and CEO as of November 2, 2026, and reports no resignation.

beats.h515: In May 2025 the Board picked David Steiner, a former Waste Management CEO, who said he'd leave the FedEx board before joining USPS.
beats.36: Reuters reported that Steiner has told associates he wants to resign. USPS said the report has 'absolutely zero validity.'

cx.now: No newer verified milestone.

usps-service-network.n: USPS service standards and processing changes
usps-service-network.s: USPS service standards have changed in phases since 2025, while local audits and reports continue to document delivery problems and scan accuracy issues.

cx.intro: USPS has been reshaping how and how fast mail moves, and shippers feel it in delivery times and tracking.

usps-finances.s: The PRC says USPS package volume fell 6% in fiscal 2025 while package revenue held flat, after a $9.5 billion fiscal 2024 loss.

cx.intro: USPS lost money two years running while its package business shifted from growth to shrinking volume, which matters for shippers.
cx.now: No newer verified milestone.

parcel-volume-amazon.n: Amazon's rise to top U.S. parcel carrier
parcel-volume-amazon.s: Amazon is now the largest U.S. carrier by volume; 2025 market totals are 23.9 billion parcels (ShipMatrix) and 23.1 billion (Pitney Bowes).

beats.h408: In 2023, Amazon Logistics grew 15.7% to 5.9 billion parcels and passed UPS at 4.6 billion. USPS still led at 6.6 billion.
beats.h522: For 2024, USPS held 31% of volume and Amazon 28%. The index projected Amazon would pass USPS by 2028.
beats.r03: Pitney Bowes also has Amazon first in 2025 at 6.9 billion, but by revenue UPS leads at 31.6% and Amazon holds 15.5%.

cx.intro: Amazon went from challenger to the biggest U.S. parcel carrier by volume. Shippers care because the market's balance is shifting.
cx.now: Amazon leads on volume in both 2025 tallies, though the totals differ: 23.9 billion (ShipMatrix) and 23.1 billion (Pitney Bowes).

usps-big-shipper-deals.n: USPS deals with Amazon and DHL eCommerce
usps-big-shipper-deals.s: USPS has signed new Amazon and DHL eCommerce agreements in 2026 and is piloting same-day delivery for Amazon; a separate international contract is now before the Commission.

beats.21: Reports said Amazon would cut its USPS volume by two-thirds. The new agreement trims it by about 20% instead.

cx.intro: USPS has locked in Amazon and DHL eCommerce as big customers, and shippers watch for what that means for its network.
cx.now: USPS's same-day pilot for Amazon added Columbia, S.C., from Oct. 20 with a 500-package cap.

amazon-network-buildout.n: Amazon opens its delivery network to all
amazon-network-buildout.s: Amazon has opened its logistics network to outside businesses and sellers, and a Loadstar comment on 2 November 2026 describes it as a carrier for hire.

beats.34: Sellers can buy LTL labels through Amazon Buy Shipping from October, and regional pricing for heavy, bulky items follows in early 2027.

cx.now: A Loadstar comment on Nov. 2 calls Amazon Logistics a carrier for hire; regional pricing for bulky items is due in early 2027.

drone-delivery.n: Drone delivery scale-up and FAA Part 108
drone-delivery.s: The FAA's Part 108 rule was unpublished as of Oct. 9, while Zipline has raised $1.5 billion and Walmart has signed for 300 more sites.

beats.g27: Amazon says Prime Air will launch near Chicago, Atlanta, Cleveland and Syracuse by end of 2026, up from 11 U.S. locations.

cx.intro: Drone delivery is scaling up while the FAA's Part 108 rule is still unpublished, which matters for who can fly routinely.

amazon-labor.n: Amazon driver labor and NLRB disputes
amazon-labor.s: An NLRB judge approved an Amazon DSP settlement without a joint-employer finding, and former drivers have sued Amazon and a closed contractor.

cx.now: The Teamsters have sought an appeal of the settlement, and the former drivers' suit seeks class status; no dates are set in the milestones.

delivery-robot-rules.s: San Jose approved delivery robot regulations, and officials will evaluate fleet data over nine months before returning to the council next fall to decide on the rules' future.

last-mile-facility-legislation.s: The companies' federal suit against the deactivation law is pending, the law is due to take effect in January, and the Delivery Protection Act (Intro. 518) was still moving through the legislative process as of Oct. 22.

beats.abf7a28de14a5: Bronx DSP operators reportedly oppose the bill, which has supermajority council support but hasn't been called for a vote.
beats.ad0f07f43ec5e: Amazon warns it could move roughly 5,000 delivery jobs out of the city; analysts say all 15 last-mile stations could close.
beats.a45eccf8e24d3: Mamdani reportedly says Amazon and other opponents are spending heavily to scare New Yorkers, and he'll join labor leaders.
beats.a831c709e5809: Teamsters rallied at City Hall Oct. 22, saying Amazon spent over $8 million against the bill; Speaker Menin hasn't set a vote.

cx.intro: NYC's Delivery Protection Act would make Amazon hire its last-mile drivers directly, so shippers watch for delivery changes.

ups-driver-choice-lawsuit.s: UPS and the Teamsters have agreed to offer the Driver Choice Program nationwide, with a 7,500-driver cap and no other severance programs through July 31, 2028.

beats.a13f12c1da7be: After a February lawsuit and March pullback in 13 central states: a 7,500-driver cap and no other severance program until 2028.
beats.abaae70647f04: Now nationwide, Central Region included: $150,000 to retire early, offered by seniority to feeder and package drivers.

cx.intro: UPS's driver buyout fight, from lawsuit to a nationwide deal, plays out under a Teamsters contract that runs to July 2028.
cx.now: Nationwide offer is capped at 7,500 drivers, with no other severance programs through July 31, 2028, when the contract expires.

royal-mail-cwu-dispute.s: The CWU has called for an emergency summit of the government, employers and union representatives over Royal Mail's staffing crisis.

cx.now: The two sides disagree on how Royal Mail is doing, and the CWU's call for a summit is still on the table. No next date is given.

uniuni.n: UniUni: funding, SPAC deal and collapse
uniuni.s: MAK terminated the UniUni purchase agreement on Oct. 20, 2026, so the planned go-public deal will not proceed; Tacoma residents' delivery complaints have also gone to the Washington Attorney General's office.

beats.61: By March 2026 it had added $30 million in equity and a $55 million RBC credit facility, bringing total funding to $285 million.

cx.intro: UniUni raised money, lined up a $1 billion go-public deal, then watched it fall apart. Shippers using it may want to know why.
cx.now: MAK reportedly ended the deal on Oct. 20, so the listing won't proceed. Tacoma delivery complaints have also reached the Washington Attorney General.

amazon-jfk8-nlrb.s: Amazon and the Teamsters filed briefs on October 16 in the Fifth Circuit over the NLRB's April order to bargain, and the court has not ruled.

theme-ecommerce-split.n: Splintering of eCommerce parcel from B2B/Premium parcel
theme-ecommerce-split.s: UPS has cut Amazon volume by more than half and FedEx has spun off Freight and sold Supply Chain, while GOFO, Veho, OnTrac and other alternative carriers keep expanding. UniUni's go-public deal was terminated on Oct. 20.

beats.h404: Shein and Temu together sent almost 600,000 U.S. packages a day, a marketplace flow big enough to tighten air cargo out of China.
beats.h417: Pitney Bowes sold a controlling stake in its Global Ecommerce unit and two entities filed Chapter 11; the unit lost about $136 million in 2023.
beats.h501: UPS stopped handing Ground Saver parcels to USPS and delivered them itself, raising Ground Saver rates by nearly 10%.
beats.h503: UPS said it will cut Amazon volume by more than half by the second half of 2026; Amazon was nearly 12% of its revenue.
beats.h513: The $800 duty-free de minimis exemption ended for China and Hong Kong goods on May 2, 2025.
beats.h521: Last-mile carrier UniUni raised $70 million to extend its North American network.
beats.h526: De minimis ended for all countries on Aug. 29, 2025; the UPU said at least 25 countries halted postal shipments to the U.S.
beats.h531: GOFO committed over $150 million to Los Angeles and Newark super hubs; it says its hubs cover 70% of the U.S. population.
beats.43: FedEx began merging its Ground and Express pickup and delivery, with the U.S. rollout complete by the end of 2027.
beats.g16: OnTrac expanded its ShipStation integration with marketplace shipping and pricing for packages under one pound.
beats.63: Veho, Better Trucks, Jitsu, OnTrac and GOFO all added coverage or services; GOFO acquired Cirro E-Commerce.
beats.g15: Veho said its network grew to 68 markets covering 46% of the U.S. population, and that parcel volume doubled.
beats.60: UniUni agreed to go public through MAK Acquisition at about US$1.0 billion, reporting more than 1 million parcels a day.
beats.g09: DHL eCommerce and USPS signed an exclusive multi-year last-mile contract valued at well over $10 billion.
beats.18: UPS closed 23 buildings and planned about 30,000 job cuts for 2026 after cutting Amazon volume by more than half.
beats.nrf79508: GOFO doubled its Dallas-area hub to 800,000 parcels a day and says its network reaches about 75% of the U.S. population.
beats.54: Priority Courier Experts, owned by Trident Management, bought three regional couriers handling over 1 million pieces a year.
beats.rv5-fedex-freight-spin-done: FedEx completed the FedEx Freight spin-off on June 1, 2026; Freight now trades separately as FDXF.
beats.52: FedEx sold FedEx Supply Chain to CMA CGM for $1.4 billion; it folds into CEVA Logistics.
beats.a66617050d4e9: Analysts disagree on whether UPS's stated focus on premium and logistics services means it will leave parts of parcel delivery.
beats.afb6fa67940a7: MAK terminated the UniUni purchase agreement on Oct. 20; the planned go-public deal will not proceed.
beats.ups-origin-zip-surcharge: UPS flags a new Ground and Ground Saver surcharge for certain origin ZIPs from Dec. 21; amount and ZIPs aren't published.
beats.a9077d9364cd5: Reportedly, NextSmartShip's CEO argues brands can mix China and U.S. fulfillment post-de minimis; it's opinion, no new rule.
beats.a089340bc097e: CMA CGM closed its $1.4 billion FedEx Supply Chain purchase (closing date Oct. 1), with multi-year ocean and air freight deals alongside.
beats.a4f6ca9e3591e: Veho announced Pulse AI on Nov. 4: brands can ask Pulse Agent plain-English questions about service performance, in beta for select clients.

cx.intro: E-commerce parcel is splitting from B2B and premium parcel: alternative carriers gain share while UPS and FedEx pull back from e-commerce.
cx.now: Both announcements came Nov. 4, 2026; the milestones give no takes-effect dates or next steps for either.

theme-ups-teamsters.n: Continued battle between UPS and the Teamsters
theme-ups-teamsters.s: The Driver Choice buyout is capped at 7,500 drivers, the Teamsters are challenging UPS over its Roadie gig deliveries, and the union's president has called a strike likely when the contract ends July 31, 2028.

beats.h406: UPS's Network of the Future plan: close or consolidate about 200 U.S. facilities and reach 400 automated buildings by the end of 2028.
beats.h511: UPS said it will cut about 20,000 positions in 2025 and close 73 buildings by the end of June.
beats.a13f12c1da7be: UPS and the Teamsters settled the Driver Choice dispute, capping it at 7,500 drivers and barring another severance program until July 31, 2028.
beats.g33: An NLRB judge approved an Amazon DSP settlement without a joint-employer finding; the Teamsters called it a 'sham settlement'.
beats.g32: Teamsters delegates voted to challenge UPS over routing work to its Roadie gig subsidiary; UPS says it complies with the contract.
beats.50: An analyst argued the 2028 outcome will reshape the market: a hard line leaning on Roadie could let UPS dominate, concessions could shrink it.
beats.35: Teamsters president Sean O'Brien said a strike is likely when the contract ends July 31, 2028.
beats.nr59b2c5: Amazon added $1.9 billion to its Delivery Service Partner program for 2027, aimed at lifting delivery associate pay to nearly $24 an hour.
beats.acb44dbafb712: An NLRB judge ruled UPS unlawfully restricted union insignia on safety vests; UPS plans to appeal.
beats.a66617050d4e9: Analysts are split on whether UPS's pivot to premium and logistics services means leaving parts of parcel, as the 2028 talks near.
beats.abaae70647f04: UPS and the Teamsters agreed to offer Driver Choice nationwide: $150,000 early-retirement payments, capped at 7,500 drivers.
beats.a57a06c26359c: Amazon TOM Team drivers at an Indiana facility joined Teamsters Local 142 and asked Amazon to recognize the union.
beats.aa1bd42ea784a: A Roadie survey, relevant as the Teamsters challenge UPS's Roadie deliveries: 64% would quit a retailer after one to four bad deliveries.

cx.intro: UPS is working to control labor costs while the Teamsters push back, and both are positioning for the contract that ends July 31, 2028.
cx.now: Driver Choice is capped at 7,500 drivers; the Teamsters' president calls a strike likely when the contract ends July 31, 2028.

theme-amazon-insourcing.n: Amazon insourcing volume (largest U.S. parcel carrier in 2025)
theme-amazon-insourcing.s: UPS finished cutting Amazon volume by more than half, Amazon and USPS agreed to trim its USPS volume by about 20%, and Amazon is opening its logistics network to outside businesses.

beats.h408: Pitney Bowes counted Amazon Logistics at 5.9 billion U.S. parcels in 2023, passing UPS at 4.6 billion; USPS led at 6.6 billion.
beats.h503: UPS said it will cut Amazon volume by more than half by the second half of 2026; UPS shares fell more than 14%.
beats.h511: UPS said it will cut about 20,000 jobs and close 73 buildings as Amazon volume shrinks.
beats.h512: Amazon said it will invest $4 billion by the end of 2026 to expand its rural delivery network to more than 200 delivery stations.
beats.h517: FedEx confirmed a multi-year deal to deliver large packages for Amazon; Amazon said it does not replace UPS capacity.
beats.19: Amazon handled 6.7 billion parcels in 2025 versus 6.6 billion for USPS, the largest U.S. carrier by volume; UPS still earns the most revenue.
beats.r01: ShipMatrix: Amazon Logistics grew 9.9% to 6.7 billion parcels in 2025 while USPS and UPS each fell 8.6%.
beats.21: After reports Amazon would cut its USPS volume by two-thirds, the two agreed to a cut of about 20%.
beats.18: UPS closed 23 buildings and planned about 30,000 job cuts after cutting Amazon volume by more than half.
beats.17: Amazon opened its logistics network, freight, warehousing and parcel delivery, to outside businesses; UPS and FedEx shares each fell about 9 to 10%.
beats.05: Business Insider reported 'Project Aurelian,' a backup plan to extend Amazon's own delivery to about 95% of U.S. ZIP codes by 2029.
beats.aba40a11b6946: An Amazon vice president said the network opened to all businesses after sellers asked to use it for off-Amazon volume.
beats.ae3846ec1ac41: Jefferies said Amazon could grow U.S. delivery stations from about 575 to 950 by 2030 and carry more third-party parcels.
beats.a63ee5425135a: An analysis says UPS's U.S. profit per package rose to about $1.16 from about $0.93 after the Amazon cutback; the math is the author's.
beats.aa3051ff662bd: On its Q3 call, UPS said Q4 U.S. daily volume should rise about 25% from Q3 but dip year over year on less Amazon volume.
beats.a632e64bf8af4: Amazon Logistics handled 6.9 billion parcels in 2025, nearly 30% of the market, while USPS slipped from 6.9 billion to 6.2 billion.

cx.intro: Amazon is moving more of its volume into its own network and opening that network to others. It was the largest U.S. parcel carrier by volume in 2025.
cx.now: UPS has finished its Amazon cutback, USPS kept most of Amazon's volume, and Amazon is selling its network to outside businesses.

usps-fuel-surcharge.s: USPS plans a permanent weekly fuel surcharge on four package services starting in January 2027, replacing the temporary 8% fee that expires January 17.

canada-post-home-delivery-ending.s: Canada Post is converting nearly four million door-to-door addresses to community mailboxes over the coming years, with the first conversions under way and weekend parcel delivery being introduced.

philly-delivery-robot-tax.s: The bill is proposed and moving through committee, where rates could be adjusted, while state law limits city regulation of the devices.

eu-low-value-imports.s: A €3 charge on parcels under €150 has applied since July and a €2 levy since 1 November, and Shein is responding by expanding EU-based fulfilment.

cx.intro: The EU now charges per-item fees and requires product IDs on low-value B2C imports, which adds cost and data work for shippers.
cx.now: The product ID rule has applied since 1 November 2026, so shippers need line-item data on every B2C parcel up to EUR 150 headed into the EU.

amazon-uber-eats-prime.s: Amazon and Uber announced the Prime restaurant delivery benefit on November 5, 2026, with the Prime Visa 5% back offer running through December 5, 2026.

doordash-instacart-deal.s: DoorDash's $17 billion deal for Instacart is pending, and some local grocers voiced concerns in early November 2026.

amazon-driver-no-poach-suit.s: A former DSP driver filed a class action in New Jersey federal court in early November 2026; the claims are unproven allegations.

amazon-teamsters-organizing.s: The Teamsters claim to have organized TOM drivers at three Amazon sites, including OIL9 in Indiana, while Amazon denies any certified bargaining unit.
